objective: Audit effective FULL_ACCESS for the Telchi DEV pilot before sales.invoice_amount.v1
AUTHORIZATION_MECHANISM: Explicit permission-code union from active/testing workspace-compatible roles and permission profiles, followed by exact membership checks and live Console re-resolution before execution
classification: Category 4: FULL_ACCESS appears as an investigative policy label, but no implemented integral identity authorization mode was found. The pilot has seven explicit role grants, not a materialized FULL_ACCESS assignment.
root_cause: Console has no integral-access semantic branch. It returns only core_role_permissions UNION core_profile_permissions. Telchi pilot admission is deliberately distinct from commercial authorization. Incremental provisioning has repeatedly created narrow roles and exact permission grants.
module_enablement: Existing private admission validated with read_approval: module_enabled=true, whole_workspace_scope_verified=true, revoked=false, identity/workspace match PostgreSQL. DB channel is horizontal_v1, dev, module=telchi, tenant=telchi. These are pilot/runtime policy and channel binding, not a generic DB module entitlement resolver. Live listener/gates/transport readiness not certified by this audit.
authorization_path: Console bearer authentication verifies PASETO subject/user identity, not permission grants.
Console bootstrap resolves the requested user's workspace then reads effective permissions from PermissionConsoleRepository.
WhatsApp channel scope is resolved from existing communication_channels metadata and workspace/provider status.
PhoneIdentityRepository requires a unique verified phone binding, active/testing user and matching tenant/workspace/environment, then invokes the Console permission resolver.
MessageDispatcher rejects mismatched identity/channel scope and enforces registration permissions. Pilot Telchi registration has no commercial grant requirement for admission.
BusinessAuthorization checks pilot revocation, fixed pilot identity, tenant/workspace/module/environment, module_enabled and whole_workspace_scope_verified.
Before capability execution, capability-specific exact permissions must exist in both the resolved identity and the live Console result when a connection is available.

Capability availability and contract constraints remain mandatory; execution validates Foundation provenance/results. Audit records required_permission, business_rbac_verified and pilot_approval_sha256, not an integral-access authorization mechanism.

tests.command: cd SrvRestAstroLS_v1/backend && uv run --no-sync pytest -q -rs modules/telchi/investigation/validation/full_access_rbac_v1/test_full_access_audit.py modules/telchi/assistant/tests/test_pilot_access.py modules/telchi/assistant/tests/test_enterprise_context.py modules/telchi/assistant/tests/test_sales_business_contract.py modules/telchi/assistant/tests/test_invoice_continuity.py tests/test_messaging_handlers.py tests/test_messaging_phone_binding_isolated.py
tests.skip_reason: Real isolated PG18 identity/migration test requires an explicit disposable DSN; none provided. No disposable database was created and DEV permissions were not mutated.
demonstrated: New permission denied with no grant, old specific grant, FULL_ACCESS, * or telchi.* strings.
New permission allowed with its explicit grant in an isolated authorization fixture.
Foreign workspace/tenant/environment denied, disabled module denied.
Live permission revocation overrides stale identity grants.
Existing capability, pilot admission revocation, pre-Foundation rejection, contract availability and scoped identity regressions pass using offline doubles.
not_demonstrated: Successful integral FULL_ACCESS execution or automatic new-capability authorization: mechanism does not exist.
Revoking a real FULL_ACCESS role: no such role exists.
Live WhatsApp execution, provider delivery or isolated PostgreSQL mutation regression.

proposal_requires_owner_authorization.decision: Implement FULL_ACCESS as an identity authorization mode assigned to an explicit tenant/workspace/module scope, dynamically evaluated by a shared authorization resolver, never by globally interpreting role names or permission prefixes.
runtime_rules: Require authenticated active identity, valid binding, exact tenant/workspace/module scope and current module enablement.
Resolve only registered, enabled capabilities whose catalog explicitly assigns them to the module. Unknown/disabled/foreign-module capabilities remain denied.
Authorize ordinary identities by existing exact grants; authorize integral identities by a live active scoped assignment without per-operation grant materialization.
Recheck scoped assignment/module status before execution and cached result reuse; preserve pilot admission and all per-capability restrictions.
Record authorization mechanism, scoped assignment/role, evaluated capability, scope and decision in audit; preserve Foundation integrity/provenance checks.
proposal_requires_owner_authorization.global_impact: PermissionConsoleRepository and shared authorization contracts, persisted scoped access metadata/schema if required, and Telchi BusinessAuthorization's exact-membership gates. Existing consumers must be inventoried and regression-tested before implementation; no changes to other identity assignments are authorized.
proposal_requires_owner_authorization.scope_to_request: Explicit exclusive GLOBAL authorization window for shared RBAC design/implementation and any required migration, plus Telchi integration and tests. After approval and tests, assign only the pilot DEV scoped access mode with backup/audit. Do not broaden other users.
